# DocumentDefinition

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Entry points for the Document Definition: a versioned, language-neutral JSON description of a whole document. Read one into a `Document` with `FromDefinitionAsync`.

Namespace `BonniePDF`.
